t: A pocket Meshtastic radio with GPS, a small screen, and long battery life.
steps: Buy the Nano G2 Ultra from the BQ Voyage store or the maker's Tindie shop.
Buy a 603450 size Li-Po battery with a JST 1.25 mm plug. Or run it from USB-C power.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Turn the radio on and pair it with the app over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match local radio rules.
Send a test message to a friend with a second Meshtastic radio.
Update firmware later with the Meshtastic web flasher or the drag-and-drop UF2 file.
